Maize Maze
Main | Maize Maze

Players must work their way through an ever-changing maze, catching implings for weapons to spook the enemies in the maze while avoiding or defeating skeletons and zombies in order to get to the centre, where a Halloween-themed version of an in-game boss can be fought.
Defeating the boss awards 700 spooky tokens and some Maize Maze spoils depending on the currently active boss and the number of double and triple loot points the player has.
Strange and golden rocks for Agility can be found by jumping over the obstacles in the maze and for Hunter by catching the implings.
Graveyard
Players may find different skilling activities for Archaeology, Farming, Prayer, Summoning and Thieving whilst engaging with the graveyard in the Harvest Hollow.
Mystery remains primarily for Archaeology
Pumpkin patches for Farming (after completing Guys and Dolls quest.)
Coffins and mausoleums primarily for Thieving
Summoning circle primarily for Summoning
Handing in Ancient remains for Prayer
Players may obtain spooky tokens from the activities. For hourly rates of obtaining spooky tokens, see Sl | Spooky tokens | #Estimated hourly rates .

Eep can be used to hand in artefacts to complete the Horrible Hollow Histories collection, as well as the bones received from the ancient remains to complete the Bounty of Bones collection in return for spooky tokens. Also, players can hand in ancient valuables and ancient heirlooms to Peckish for spooky tokens. Lastly, the various gourds from the pumpkin patches can be handed into the harvest cart to fulfil Dolly's pumpkin orders to receive spooky tokens.
Strange and golden rocks for Farming can be found by depositing pumpkins into the harvest cart.
Stage
The reward shops in the area are located in front of the stage. Scuffle and the Maize Maze portal are located north of the stage.
Bonfire

The bonfire may be used like any other bonfire, granting firemaking experience for adding logs. It will also provide spooky tokens with every log and has a chance to grant ancient remains when logs are added. Once Guys and Dolls has been completed, special coloured logs provided by Guy can be used instead.
The bank chest in the area are located north-east of the bonfire.

West of the bonfire is a field with five yaks with four of them being zombie yaks while the fifth is a living one ("An average yak", according to the examine). All of them wander in the field except the biggest one which is standing in front of the fence, close to one of the two drinking troughs, and is "an aggressive yak", again according to the examine. The remaining three zombie yaks are the same size and are "hungry", "sickly", or "dead". Judging from their examine texts, each one pulls one of the five caravans by the bonfire and is therefore associated with one of the Horsemen: Death ("dead"), Famine ("hungry"), Frank ("average"), Pestilence ("sickly"), and War ("aggressive").
Death's mansion
Main | Death's mansion
Death's mansion is located in the Harvest Hollow currently. A gate is blocking the way to the mansion.
